description.value: Dan Bosch Park is a nature reserve on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, operated by the Sunshine Coast Regional District and situated directly along the Sunshine Coast Highway — a popular touring corridor. The park permits leashed dogs, suggesting trail access suitable for active visitors. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a scenic roadside stop, though specific on-site facilities are not documented.
